# Representative volume element of mixed oxide fuel (example ex7 of
# mfem-mgis-examples: one spherical inclusion in a matrix, periodic
# boundary conditions, Norton viscoplasticity with a threshold, quadratic
# tetrahedra), with its behaviour generated by the generic-parallel
# interface. The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its
# build directory, the behaviour library being given by its option -l; the
# mode of integration is given by the environment variables of mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/../mfem-mgis-examples/ex7"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex7 of mfem-mgis-examples")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex7-behaviours CUDA
  "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex7/NortonViscoplasticityWithThreshold.mfront")

# short tests: the five time steps of the restricted test mode of the
# example on two processes, the mean stresses in each material being
# compared to the reference values of the example, point by point (generic
# library of the example), all the computations by kernels with the generic
# library and by batches with each backend. All the tests write the mean
# stresses in the same file of the build directory of the example.
if(EXISTS "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR}/mox2")
  set(_run mpirun -n 2 ./mox2 --no-post-processing --order 2
           --mesh mesh/OneSphere.msh --nbsteps 5
           --reference-file OneSphere-avgStress-5steps.ref)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  add_test(NAME ex7-point-par-point COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ex7-noyaux COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ex7-point-par-point PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
  set_tests_properties(ex7-noyaux PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
  set(_tests ex7-point-par-point ex7-noyaux)
  foreach(_backend ${ex7-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      add_test(NAME ex7-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} --device cuda -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex7-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}"
        RESOURCE_LOCK gpu)
    else()
      add_test(NAME ex7-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX7_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex7-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=2;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
    endif()
    list(APPEND _tests ex7-batch-${_backend})
  endforeach()
  set_tests_properties(${_tests} PROPERTIES RESOURCE_LOCK ex7-avgStress)
  # the GPU test holds both locks
  if(TEST ex7-batch-cuda)
    set_tests_properties(ex7-batch-cuda PROPERTIES
      RESOURCE_LOCK "gpu;ex7-avgStress")
  endif()
endif()
